[[File:Kufbrug_SWJ14.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Matron Kufbrug]]
'''Matrons''' were the female leaders of a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clan. The most powerful of the females was the '''Clan Matron''' and was married to the clan [[Warlord (Gamorrean)/Legends|Warlord]]. The matrons formed the [[Council of Matrons]] that governed each clan.

==Known matrons==
*[[Kufbrug]] - Clan Matron of [[Bolgoink clan]]
*[[Gundruk]] - Matron of Bolgoink clan
*[[Bullyak]] - Clan Matron of [[Gakfedd tribe|Gakfedd clan]]
*[[Mugshub]] - Clan Matron of [[Klagg tribe|Klagg clan]]
